capabilities: Render Laws of Form expressions in lof code blocks
Draw crosses, nested spaces and re-entries
Separate expressions with a configurable separator keyword
Customize expression styling with inline or global CSS
extras: README documents a technical limitation: each Re-Entry can re-enter into at most two spaces because of CSS pseudo-element constraints, and complex nested Re-Entries may cause display errors.
problem: Obsidian has no way to render Laws of Form notation graphically; bracket expressions only appear as plain text.
summary: Renderer that displays Laws of Form bracket expressions like ((a)(b)) as their two-dimensional graphical form inside lof code blocks.
